title: OAB 47 preliminary answer key: what you need to know
seoTitle: OAB 47 Preliminary Answer Key: What You Need to Know
subtitle: Understand how the release works and the possibility of appealing the first-phase answer key
excerpt: The first phase of the 47th OAB Exam was held this Sunday, September 6, 2026, and FGV has already released the preliminary answer key.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The big day has arrived: this Sunday, September 6, 2026, thousands of law graduates and students completed the first phase of the 47th OAB Exam. Shortly after, the Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) and the Federal Council of the OAB published the official preliminary answer key, generating intense interest among candidates.

How the preliminary answer key was released

According to the opening notice, FGV makes the official preliminary answer key available by 10 p.m. on the day of the exam, on the organizing committee's website (http://oab.fgv.br). This publication allows candidates to check their performance before the final answer key is released.

What the live broadcast offers

Teachers from Gran Cursos Online corrected the exam live starting at 5 p.m., presenting the organizing committee's reasoning and pointing out potential discrepancies. The broadcast helps candidates understand the logic behind each question and identify items that could be subject to appeal.

Procedure for filing an appeal

Anyone who finds an inconsistency or a question that violates the syllabus can appeal exclusively online, through the Electronic Appeal Submission System on the FGV portal. Each examinee can file one appeal per question, limited to 5,000 characters.

Consequences of an annulment

If the National Coordination annuls a question during the appeal phase, the corresponding point will be awarded to all candidates who took the exam, as established by the regulations.

Next steps for those who achieved the minimum score

Candidates who achieve the required 40 correct answers (50% of the exam) immediately begin preparing for the second phase, the Practical-Professional Exam. The preliminary answer key, therefore, serves as a decision-making milestone for those moving forward.

With information from Blog Gran Cursos Online.
